summary_1line: Bhishma urges Yudhishthira to rule actively rather than renounce, explaining kingly duty and how a ruler should judge and manage Brahmanas by conduct.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma, lying on his bed of arrows, raises his hand while advising the troubled Yudhishthira who stands beside him in royal garments.
A righteous king sits on a throne as frightened villagers approach him for protection while soldiers stand ready to punish wrongdoers.
A majestic tree heavy with fruit shelters many birds beneath its branches, symbolizing people taking refuge under a just king.
